disclaimer_prototype: This is a training simulation prototype, not a substitute for official industrial safety certification.
fire_learn_slide_1: A fire emergency can escalate in seconds. Immediate, correct response — not panic — protects lives.
fire_learn_slide_2: Extinguishers are matched to fire type: water for ordinary combustibles, CO2/DCP/foam for oil, grease, or electrical fires. Water on an electrical or oil fire can spread it or cause shock.
fire_learn_slide_3: Remember PASS: Pull the pin, Aim at the base, Squeeze the handle, Sweep side to side. Always know your nearest marked exit before an emergency happens.
gas_learn_slide_1: Confined spaces can trap toxic gas or displace oxygen without any visible warning sign.
gas_learn_slide_2: Never enter a confined space without testing the atmosphere with a calibrated gas detector and obtaining an entry permit.
gas_learn_slide_3: Always use the buddy system: an attendant stays outside, monitors conditions, and can call for rescue immediately if the alarm sounds.
no_ar_support_title: AR not supported on this device
no_ar_support_body: This device or emulator does not support ARCore. You can still complete Learning and Assessment; the guided/independent practice scenario will show as a flat preview.
ar_module_missing_body: AR could not start on this build of the app. You can still continue — try reinstalling the latest app build if this persists.
camera_permission_body: This app needs camera access to run the AR training scenario.
